title: 3 所谓天赋4 寿老5 辅系天赋
slug: 在诡异世界变成蜘蛛精
content_zh:
：时间过了不知道多久。
贺堪再次清醒过来，发现自己浑身疲惫至极，还有点酸痛，睁开眼睛，抬头，对上的是头顶的屋粱，鼻尖闻到的是淡淡药香。
贺堪忍不住眨了眨眼睛，挣扎着从床上抬起上半身。
这个时候，他才发现自己好像到了类似医馆之类的地方，看装饰应该是古代之类的，比起唐宋更偏向夏周的古朴，不少都有打磨精美的石器与青铜器摆设。
“扣扣！”
木门外面传来敲门的声音，不急不缓。
贺堪这才抬头看向木门，开口道：“请进。”
门被从外面推开了，一群监天司的士兵在门口，其中一位贺堪十分眼熟，正是当初手中拿着符箓指着他大声叫唤的少年。
只不过这次这位少年没有之前的一往无前，多了几分小心翼翼，时不时还偷看最前面成熟稳重的中年监天司司士。
“初次见面，我乃监天司司士—邹平司。”
为首的中年男人先是看了眼床上的贺堪，确认其意志清醒之后，这才点点头，率先开始介绍，说话十分稳重，不急不缓，没有丝毫傲慢。
贺堪点点头，语气有些虚弱的道：“邹大人，您可称我贺堪。”
“可否告知你为何在小平村的河流处？”
邹平司抬眸问向贺堪，他手中拿着纸笔，这一点也跟贺堪记忆中的不同，明明用着青铜器却有纸笔。
不知道什么时候，门口的一众监天司士兵都已离开，只剩下一开始的那个少年，来到了邹平司的身后。
邹平司进来后，随手关上门在床不远处坐下。
贺堪明白这是在调查他，情理当中，当即不准备隐瞒，十分直白的将自己的事情全部告知：“我家住百余里外的小贺村，此次进城，乃是因为村外诡异实在众多，村里之前术师因年老逝世，农事更是无法进行，幸好某曾经得术师青眼，测的有一些术师天赋，这才往大启城这边求学。”
“没想到半路上遇到商队，强行掳走，作为血食。”
“至于剩下的，某就不知道了。”
贺堪斟酌着开口。

至于什么蜘蛛，什么幻像，抱歉，他就是一个普通平民，真的什么都不知道。
一位普通平民遭遇这件事情，没大呼小叫很是可以了，只是少许记忆不清，反而正常的很。
“那商队首领有喂你吃过什么东西吗？”
邹平司突兀的询问了一句。
“有。”
贺堪没有隐瞒的意思，直白的将自己遭遇说出来，道：“是一群人抓住我喂的，只不过当时神智模糊，记不太清楚，回到关住我的监牢，也只来得及将药吐到隐蔽地方，随后就昏迷了。”
“再次醒来就是被血祭的时候。”
邹平司看来对于贺堪的话语没有怀疑的意思，点点头，在纸上时不时用纸写写画画，之后又问了很多。
贺堪知无不言。
大约差不多半个时辰之后，邹平司的问题才全部问完，此时连贺堪都觉得有些累了。
邹平司这才收起纸笔，他抬起脸庞，他样貌十分普通，只有一双眼睛漆黑如墨，简直如同望进别人心中，周身气质也因为这双眼睛加分不少，顿了顿，他看似平淡的开口：“你说你上大启城是为了成为术师？”
求学直接就被他理解成了想当术师。
当然，这么理解也不是不可以。
贺堪点头，他的确是这样想的，一觉醒来，贺堪记忆多了不少，包括那个偏僻荒芜的小村落，还有记忆中有些老朽的村民，自然，也包括原身对于这个世界的记忆。
这个世界大多数都被诡异所占据，普通人时时刻刻都面临诡异的威胁，成为血食，即使再监天司的附近，诡物食人事件时有发生。
术师是唯一对抗诡异的手段。
“正有此意。”
content_en:
: I don’t know how long time has passed.
He Kan woke up again and found that he was extremely tired and a little sore. He opened his eyes, raised his head, and saw the roof beam above his head. The tip of his nose smelled a faint scent of medicine.
He Kan couldn't help blinking his eyes and struggling to lift his upper body from the bed.
At this time, he realized that he seemed to be in a place similar to a medical hall. The decoration should be ancient times, more like the simplicity of the Xia and Zhou Dynasties than the Tang and Song Dynasties. Many of them had exquisitely polished stoneware and bronze furnishings.
"Button!"
There was a knocking sound outside the wooden door, not urgent nor slow.
He Kan then looked up at the wooden door and said, "Please come in."
The door was pushed open from the outside, and a group of soldiers from the Tiantiansi were at the door. One of them looked very familiar to He Kan. He was the young man who pointed at him and shouted with the talisman in his hand.
It's just that this time the young man was not as forward-thinking as before, and was a little more cautious. From time to time, he would peek at the mature and steady middle-aged Supervisor Tiansi at the front.
"This is the first time we meet, I am the Supervisor of the Supervisory Heaven Division—Zou Pingsi."
The middle-aged man in the lead first glanced at He Kan on the bed, and after confirming that he was conscious, he nodded and started the introduction first. His words were very steady, unhurried and without any arrogance.
He Kan nodded and said in a weak tone: "Master Zou, you can call me He Kan."
"Can you tell me why you are at the river in Xiaoping Village?"
Zoupingsi raised his eyes and asked He Kan. He was holding a pen and paper in his hand. This was different from what He Kan remembered. He was clearly using bronze but had paper and pen.
At some point, all the Tiantiansi soldiers at the door had left, leaving only the young man from the beginning who came behind Zoupingsi.
After Zoupingsi came in, he closed the door and sat down not far from the bed.
He Kan understood that this was an investigation of him, so he was not prepared to hide it immediately, and told everything about himself very straightforwardly: "My family lives in Xiaohe Village, which is more than a hundred miles away. This time I came to the city because there are so many weird things outside the village. The previous magician in the village died of old age, and farming was not possible. Fortunately, a certain magician once favored him, and he was tested to have some talent as a magician, so he went to Daqicheng to study."
"I didn't expect to encounter a caravan on the way and forcibly kidnapped them to use as blood food."
"As for the rest, I don't know."
He Kan spoke carefully.
As for spiders and illusions, I'm sorry, he is just an ordinary civilian and really doesn't know anything.
It was fine for an ordinary civilian to encounter this incident, and he didn't make any fuss. He just had some unclear memory, but it was quite normal.
"Did the caravan leader feed you anything?"
Zoupingsi asked suddenly.
"Yes."
He Kan had no intention of concealing anything and told his story straightforwardly, saying: "A group of people caught me and fed me. It's just that I was confused at the time and can't remember clearly. When I returned to the prison where I was imprisoned, I only had time to spit out the medicine into a hidden place, and then I fell into a coma."
"When you wake up again, you will be sacrificed by blood."
Zou Pingsi seemed to have no doubts about He Kan's words. He nodded and wrote and drew on the paper from time to time, and then asked many more questions.
He Kan knew everything and said nothing.
About half an hour later, Zoupingsi finished asking all the questions. At this time, even He Kan felt a little tired.
Only then did Zoupingsi put away his paper and pen. He raised his face. His appearance was very ordinary. He only had a pair of eyes as dark as ink, which seemed to look into the hearts of others. His overall aura was also enhanced by these eyes. After a pause, he said in a seemingly plain voice: "You said you went to Daqicheng to become a magician?"
Studying was directly understood by him as wanting to be a magician.
Of course, this is not impossible to understand.
He Kan nodded, he indeed thought so. When he woke up, He Kan had a lot more memories, including the remote and desolate small village, and the memoryThe memory of some old villagers naturally includes the original person's memory of this world.
Most of this world is occupied by strange things. Ordinary people face strange threats all the time and become blood-eating. Even in the vicinity of Jian Tiansi, incidents of cannibalism by strange creatures occur from time to time.
The magician is the only way to fight against the strange.
"That's exactly what I meant."
